srList.sentence: Patients were excluded if: (1) primary PCI for an occluded or stenosed culprit vessel was not attempted during the acute phase of MI; (2) they had an arrhythmia disturbing GLS and TMAD measurement, such as atrial fibrillation and multiple extra beats; (3) they underwent incomplete echocardiographic study or their images were not stored; and (4) they had poor image quality that rendered the images unsuitable for analysis.
